name: Escape Papa Pizza's Pizzeria! (SCARY OBBY)
desc:
-NOTE: This game has mild Jump scares!

Oh look a new Pizzeria has opened in town, Wait? This is PAPA PIZZA'S PIZZERIA!! This isn't good. Papa Pizza has been known to add a secret ingredient to his Pizza's......HUMAN!! 

So it looks like you have been misled to Papa's Pizzeria and are Trapped inside. Can you make your way through the Pizzeria and face the horrors that await :O 
Bare in mind you are also getting chased by Papa Pizza Himself!! 
Can you make it out of his Pizzeria Alive and make it home?

If you enjoy these Scary Themed Obby's please leave a like and support the game :D
